name: imbalance_auc_recall
topic: regularization techniques that improve AUC on imbalanced tabular data
gold_source: Mean of 4 independent scoring passes over the 352-paper pool of the strongest configuration (search_top_k=50, max_seconds=1800, 2026-08-17), kept at mean >= 0.45. Averaging is deliberate: a gold picked from a SINGLE noisy pass selects papers that got a lucky draw, so any later run regresses toward the mean and shows a phantom loss at the scoring stage — measured at -0.110 mean score on such a gold versus +0.004 with no score-conditioning. This is still a PROXY gold: one scorer's averaged judgement, not human ground truth. It answers the R@all question (how much of what a strong run finds does a cheaper run recover), not 'how much exists'.
